maddeler.e:
انمحقت (form VII)
# اِنْمَحَقْتُ (inmaḥaqtu) /in.ma.ħaq.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِنْمَحَقَ (inmaḥaqa)
# اِنْمَحَقْتَ (inmaḥaqta) /in.ma.ħaq.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِنْمَحَقَ (inmaḥaqa)
# اِنْمَحَقْتِ (inmaḥaqti) /in.ma.ħaq.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِنْمَحَقَ (inmaḥaqa)
# اِنْمَحَقَتْ (inmaḥaqat) /in.ma.ħa.qat/: third-person
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
